'''Jonny Law''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[October 2001 Sydney tournament]] on 14 October 2001 with RTP, according to Jason Baretta's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3054">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-14-sydney-14-10-01d3054/ sydney-14-10-01], DeckTech (jason "zwitter" baretta, 14 October 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-14-sydney-14-10-01d3054/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
